FOUND WRONG: self-service compared an id to a code and never saved; its handler ran twice; govt HRA/PT used the first employee's branch for a whole group; a status rule aborted every close; specificity counted boxes.

GOT WRONG FIRST: filtered bank-advice rows for scoped users, which broke reconciliation — replaced with a whole-company-only guard.

TESTS: scope_line_only 15, module_reach 7, payroll_org_wiring 13, org_rename 10, role_grant 7, org_consistency 5; scope_branch_reach/component_rules/transfers updated where behaviour changed on purpose; no new failures in the local suite. composer check NOT run.

title: Paid days / deductions wired; muster = payroll; statutory during probation; multi-branch Branch Admin; request notifications; EMI and probation-completion emails; layout guards; roster sample follows the live filter
detail:
Owner 8 Oct. BUILT: PayrollPeriod — paid leave on a holiday scoped to another company/branch is paid (classification per employee, not the unscoped calendar); half day + paid leave = one full day; late-login cut only on a day paid as worked and never on paid leave, capped at the day; working_days basis no longer pays W.OFF/holidays on top. Attendance card payable = payroll's figure. Muster: leave across W.OFF stays W.OFF, unpaid leave shown as LOP (UNPAID_LEAVE), approved leave decides a punched-but-ABSENT day, nothing after exit_date; summary adds Unpaid leave + Late-login cut and Payable is net of both. Probation: per-head applicable/not applicable during probation (default none), tenant default on the Probation board and per company inside each company box; StatutoryApplicability honours it at close (as of the month end — confirmation after the month keeps it a probation month), salary screen, payslip label, and filters statutory-engine rows. Scope: Branch Admin's extra branches (Directory, kept as admin_branches beside the record). RequestNotices: leave, regularisation, workflow requests, transfers and declared request registers tell the whole line up, branch admins and company-wide roles (bell + Notifications), one message per recipient. Alert emails: probation_completed and emi_deduction (Recoveries engine). CSS layout guards; hidden f_* fields take the live filter bar values on submit.

FOUND WRONG: regularisation notification shared one dedupe key across recipients, so only the first was told. Late cut double-charged absent/leave days. Muster said L on Sundays inside a leave.

GOT WRONG FIRST: an apostrophe inside a Python-written PHP string broke app.php's parse; caught by php -l.
checks: New: payroll_days_wiring 9, attendance_report_wiring 9, probation_statutory 17, request_notices 12, scope_branch_reach +4, alert_emails +4 — all pass; no new failures vs the unchanged copy across the staged suite; composer check not run (no composer on the cloud copy).

title: Payroll accuracy — roster shifts, shift grace, late minutes, half-day leave, leave in days, scoped accrual, start-date availability
detail:
Owner: no miscalculation in payroll or payslips. Attendance now settles EACH DATE on that date's shift (Roster row, then the scoped Working Shift, then the caller's default) and marks lateness with the shift's own Grace when it declares one; every day carries late_raw (minutes past the shift start). Attendance::penalties() takes the dates on approved leave and never counts them as late marks; LatePolicy and the published penalty rule read late_raw, so a policy's grace is the only grace. PayrollPeriod: penalties exclude any leave date (paid or unpaid, half or whole); new paid_leave_days / unpaid_leave_days in days with halves (paid = leave-only halves + the half that tops up a half-worked day); the why-line and the payslip breakdown now add up to the payable figure; a half day worked + a half day of paid leave is no longer reported as an overlap. Register stores the day counts in days; payslip / register / live salary / payroll screen print them. Leave::accrueThrough() accrues only types the employee is eligible for (company/branch scope) — shared eligibilityContext() with openBalances(). Leave::validate() counts a half-day request in halves (0.5 against 0.5 is allowed). leaveAvailability() takes an as-of date: Apply (server split), the leave-days count endpoint (form confirm) and Leave Approvals use the balance on the leave's start date. config/leave-rules.json: the balance rules apply to PAID types only (LOP was refused outright). AttendanceReport muster: leave dates are not late marks and carry no late cut.

FOUND WRONG: payroll settled a rostered afternoon against the general shift (HALF_DAY + regularisation); the late-login policy compared its grace with minutes already reduced by the calendar grace (effective 15 for a 10-minute policy); Working Shifts' Grace was never read; first-half leave days counted as late marks; 0.5 LOP printed as 0; ABC Recoveries EL accrued for Ametecs staff and vice versa; back-dated applies judged on today's balance.

GOT WRONG FIRST: the seeder made up lateness at the end of a first-half-leave day and let afternoon-shift out-punches cross midnight; one landed on exactly 00:00:00, which Punch refuses — repaired in the data.
checks: New tests/payroll_accuracy_test.php: 14 assertions, written first and failing for the right reasons, now pass. Full staged suite (48 files): no new failures against the unchanged copy. php -l clean on every changed file. composer check not run (no composer in the cloud copy).

title: Gates green: no-empty-catch and no-float-money (28 violations)
detail:
composer check on the Laragon PC failed two gates. no-empty-catch: three catches carried gate:allow-swallow while not swallowing (annotation removed); LatePolicy roles, Register and Settlement increments catches annotated with the condition they tolerate. no-float-money: leave availability and the half-day test now use Rational (app.php split + Apply option, Leave::halfOf, Leave Balance Report all-zero test, Late Login Policy cut select and hours display); TablePdf point geometry and the appraisal sample's rating-scale bounds allow-listed by line text with reasons (not amounts); the retired dev screens are stubs.

FOUND WRONG: re-committing a file from the SAME container staging path can write the PREVIOUS bytes to the PC — the second PayrollPeriod / payroll_accuracy_test / build-journal commits and three dev-screen stubs had landed stale. This, not opcache, is why edited screens earlier in the day seemed not to change. Every commit now goes from a fresh staging directory and is re-staged and byte-compared.
checks: php tools/gates/gate.php --only=no-empty-catch,no-float-money: PASS (cloud copy of the changed files). Test suite: no new failures; payroll_accuracy 15/15. Full composer check to be re-run on the PC.

title: Payroll delete fixed; deep links land on the field app-wide
detail:
Register::discard wrote '<period> · deleted <stamp>' into payroll_corrections.period/settled_in (varchar 7) and MySQL refused it, so 'delete all payroll' stopped at 2026-05. A deleted run's corrections now stay in their period and are parked as settled in it (never paid as arrears). correctionsFor() skips corrections whose `corrects` run is discarded, so a regenerated month starts clean. title: Requisition approval chain, final approvers, Recruitment screen tidy
detail: Owner (12 Oct): a requisition is approved by the respective department's Director or the Branch Admin, then HR Admin; 'The Company Admin approval or HR Admin approval for any requests overrides any other approvals'. config/recruitment.json requisition.approval_steps declares the chain: pending → pending_hr → approved. Recruitment::decideRequisition and Requests::decide ($finalApprover, passed by app.php and decide-claim.php) close as approved when a final approver approves at any step. approved_by keeps every approver in order. Requisitions waiting on you now appear in the Approvals Inbox with Approve/Reject, and the decide action is gated by the step, not by a blanket permission (the engine fails closed). Built: (1) Hiring Process tab, now the first tab: the nine steps (requisition → approval → job post on portals → download and import applicants → screening → interview → offer → hire → onboarding/probation), each with its live count and a button to where it is done, plus 'What each source brought' (Recruitment::sourceReport, candidates per portal by stage and hire rate). (2) Job Postings tab: one job post per approved, open requisition (surface/JobPostings.php, table job_postings via migration 2026_10_12_000100, file-store fallback with banner until it runs); the portal pack (each field in a copy box, Copy everything, Download job post as Word); per-portal how-to-post / how-to-download steps declared in config/recruitment.json → portals; Mark as posted (portal, portal job ID, link, posted, expires; expired flagged); each posting shows applicants imported from that portal and an Import applicants button preset to it. Requisitions table: Posted on column. (3) Import candidates reads the portal's own download: .csv, .xlsx, .xls, and the HTML-table '.xls' some portals send (Sheet::htmlTableToCsv); headers matched against config import_columns (Naukri 'Phone Number', 'Annual Salary', 'Total Experience'; LinkedIn First/Last Name …); 'INR 5.5 Lacs', '12 Lakhs 50 Thousand', '3.25 LPA', '2 Year(s) 6 Month(s)', 'Fresher' read exactly with scaled integers (Recruitment::amount / years; a bare number under 100 is lakhs, 100–999 refused); notice period, education, preferred location kept in notes; a free portal job title not in Designations goes to notes; same email or last-10 mobile digits = duplicate, skipped and counted; the notice names which column became what and which were not used; portal and requisition chosen in the dialog. Sources are now the portals (naukri, linkedin, indeed, foundit, shine, apna, workindia, company_website …). (4) Offer: Recruitment::recordOffer at the Offer stage (CTC, joining date, notes; status sent); the offer letter is the Letters 'offer' template filled from the candidate, printable; the Hire form now starts from the offered CTC / date, the requisition's company and the candidate's designation. Resume link on the candidate page. (5) Sample data screen dev-seed-recruit-t: a requisition per company/designation/department/branch of the joiners since 1 Feb 2026, each approved and posted on 2–4 portals, every joiner a hired candidate (offer accepted, two interview rounds) linked by employee code; October requisitions pending Director, pending HR Admin, rejected, and one approved with 6 openings; 15 candidates across applied/screening/interview (round 2 scheduled)/offer (one with offer sent)/rejected (with reasons, one no-show) and 3 in the talent pool. Got wrong first: the re-save test blanked the experience fields (form posts every field, so the test was reordered); seeded requisitions dated December 2025 (raise date moved to 30 days before joining). Not built: posting to portals by API (paid partner integrations) — HR posts by hand from the portal pack. Test first: recruitment_portal 41/41; recruitment 41/41.

title: Geo-fence enforced on web / phone punch-in
detail: Owner (12 Oct): 'Yes, it should be checked while logging in and allow punch in only if it is within the specified range'. surface/GeoFence.php: the fence is the newest Geo-Fence Rule for the employee (lat, lng, radius, Outside Rule Strict / 1km / 2km = extra tolerance), else Home Latitude / Longitude / Allowed Radius on the record; nobody fenced = no check (biometric office staff unaffected). Haversine distance. self-punch: an IN punch outside radius + tolerance, or without a location, is refused with the distance and the allowed radius, and audited (attendance.punch.refused_geofence); OUT punches are recorded wherever they happen, with their location. The Punch screen says 'Geo-fence on: punch-in allowed only within N km of your home location / office point'. Test first: geofence 11/11. Known limit: the browser reports the location, so a spoofed GPS is not detected.

Punch (app): SmartEPT company = no punch, told to use SmartEPT; QR company = Scan QR (live camera via jsQR, photo fallback), GPS sent with it; self-punch verifies in SmartEPT's order (code/signature, age <= interval+grace, gate active, gate at Home or handled branch, GPS accuracy, distance, repeat scan) and records source 'qr' with reference qr:<gate>:<window>|gps|distance; refusals audited (attendance.punch.refused_qr). Standard companies unchanged. Android: CAMERA permission + WebView onPermissionRequest; selfie asks for camera first (Android blocks the camera app once CAMERA is declared); version 1.1 (code 2). Vendored public/js/qrcode.min.js (from SmartEPT) and public/js/jsQR.js (jsQR 1.4.0, Apache-2.0).

title: Mobile app sign-in like SmartEPT + activation codes; source dropdown without Standard
detail: Owner 11:21: first sign-in on a phone asks for an activation code; a registered phone signs straight in with that profile's menus. public/mobile.php: /api/mobile/signin (password checked, per-phone pause after 5 wrong tries) and /api/mobile/activate (single-use hashed code, 72 h, versioned customisation mobile-activation; phone approved or waiting per QR Attendance phone approval; a phone-approval exception / no-approval company needs no code). One-time login link (storage/app-login, 120 s, that phone only) spent in boot-hooks → Session::signInVerified. Admin: 'Mobile app activation code' card on Mobile Devices and QR Attendance → Phones (action mobile-activation: emails the code and shows it once). App v1.2 (MainActivity via dev-write-app-src-y, copied): sign-in screen, Activate screen, Waiting screen; SmartPRS's own sign-in page returns to the app's. Old /register + /status kept for v1.1 phones. Owner 11:25: Standard removed from the Attendance source dropdown; company 'No approval' relabelled 'whole company', with a pointer to per-person phone exceptions for a demo login.
wrong_first: No Android SDK in the cloud session, so the Java was not compiled here — Android Studio build is the check. tests/mobile_activation_test.php 19/19 (cloud).

title: HR Letters: Send on every letter page; Offer letter for a new candidate
detail: Owner 11:32/11:33: Offer / Increment / Warning / Relieving / NDA pages (surface/partials/letters-kind.php → new letters-issue-card.php, now above the wording): pick the employee, the letter is drafted on the page, then Send to <email> / Issue without email / Print, with subject, CC, copy the reporting line, LOP when the template carries it — the same letter-issue action, which now returns to the page it came from (app.php: return_route). Offer letters: Existing employee | New candidate; New = typed name, email, mobile, address, company → branch (dependent), designation, date of joining, annual CTC, signatory, CC; Preview / Send (action offer-new: same renderer and salary annexure, refuses blanks, emails, keeps the text in letters with no employee — listed as 'New candidate').
wrong_first: Label read 'Send a increment letter' — now 'Send the …'. Card moved above the long wording so Send is seen without scrolling.
